func cacheTLS(ctx context.Context, client *dagger.Client, base, flipt *dagger.Container, conf testConfig) func() error {
	cert := &x509.Certificate{
		SerialNumber:          big.NewInt(1),
		DNSNames:              []string{"redis"},
		NotBefore:             time.Now().Add(-time.Hour),
		NotAfter:              time.Now().Add(24 * time.Hour),
		KeyUsage:              x509.KeyUsageDigitalSignature | x509.KeyUsageCertSign,
		ExtKeyUsage:           []x509.ExtKeyUsage{x509.ExtKeyUsageServerAuth},
		BasicConstraintsValid: true,
		IsCA:                  true,
	}
	der, err := x509.CreateCertificate(rand.Reader, cert, cert, &priv.PublicKey, priv)
	if err != nil {
		return func() error { return err }
	}
	certPEM := string(pem.EncodeToMemory(&pem.Block{Type: "CERTIFICATE", Bytes: der}))
	keyPEM := string(pem.EncodeToMemory(&pem.Block{Type: "RSA PRIVATE KEY", Bytes: x509.MarshalPKCS1PrivateKey(priv)}))

	redisSrv := client.Container().
		From("redis:alpine").
		WithNewFile("/server.crt", dagger.ContainerWithNewFileOpts{Contents: certPEM}).
		WithNewFile("/server.key", dagger.ContainerWithNewFileOpts{Contents: keyPEM}).
		WithExposedPort(6379).
		WithExec([]string{"redis-server", "--port", "0", "--tls-port", "6379", "--tls-cert-file", "/server.crt", "--tls-key-file", "/server.key", "--tls-ca-cert-file", "/server.crt", "--tls-auth-clients", "no"})

	flipt = flipt.
		WithServiceBinding("redis", redisSrv.AsService()).
		WithNewFile("/etc/flipt/redis-ca.pem", dagger.ContainerWithNewFileOpts{Contents: certPEM}).
		WithEnvVariable("FLIPT_LOG_LEVEL", "DEBUG").
		WithEnvVariable("FLIPT_CACHE_ENABLED", "true").
		WithEnvVariable("FLIPT_CACHE_BACKEND", "redis").
		WithEnvVariable("FLIPT_CACHE_REDIS_HOST", "redis").
		WithEnvVariable("FLIPT_CACHE_REDIS_REQUIRE_TLS", "true").
		WithEnvVariable("FLIPT_CACHE_REDIS_CA_CERT_PATH", "/etc/flipt/redis-ca.pem")

	return suite(ctx, "api", base, flipt.WithExec(nil), conf)
}

Implemented Redis TLS support in [RedisCacheConfig](/app/internal/config/cache.go) and the new [redis.NewClient](/app/internal/cache/redis/client.go). The client supports a CA file, inline certificate data, system trust, and optional certificate verification bypass, with TLS 1.2 as the minimum. Configuration rejects both CA options together with the required error message.

Added YAML fixtures, schema updates, constructor tests, and `api/cachetls` to the integration registry and GitHub Actions matrix. Config and command tests pass; the constructor tests pass. The container backed Redis and integration suites could not run because Docker is unavailable here.
